name: Godot-Claude-Skills
headline: Godot-Claude-Skills: AI-Powered Game Development
short_description: Godot-Claude-Skills integrates Claude AI into the Godot game engine for automating development tasks. Developers use it to generate game logic, manage assets, and accelerate level design through AI-assisted scripting. Reduces manual coding overhead in game projects.
author: Randroids-Dojo

sections.overview:
Godot-Claude-Skills is a Claude Code skill that streamlines Godot 4.x game development by integrating AI-assisted automation for testing, building, and deployment. It includes GdUnit4 integration for unit and scene testing, PlayGodot framework for end-to-end game automation, and Python helper scripts for running tests and exporting builds. The skill supports web and desktop exports, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, and deployment to Vercel, GitHub Pages, and itch.io. Game developers use it to accelerate testing workflows, automate builds, and reduce manual deployment overhead across their projects.
Generate GDScript code for game mechanics and interactive systems
Automate asset management and level design tasks
Accelerate prototyping by AI-assisted code generation
Debug and refactor existing Godot game scripts

# Automated Enemy AI Behavior for Godot

Here's a script to automate enemy AI behavior in your Godot game. This script will make enemies patrol between waypoints, chase the player when detected, and attack when in range.

```gdscript
extends CharacterBody2D

# Waypoints for patrol
var waypoints = []
var current_waypoint = 0
var speed = 200
var chase_speed = 300
var attack_range = 200
var player_detected = false

func _ready():
    # Initialize waypoints (replace with your own waypoints)
    waypoints = [$Vector2(100, 100), $Vector2(300, 100), $Vector2(300, 300), $Vector2(100, 300)]

func _process(delta):
    if player_detected:
        chase_player(delta)
    else:
        patrol(delta)

func patrol(delta):
    var target_position = waypoints[current_waypoint]
    var direction = (target_position - position).normalized()
    velocity = direction * speed
    move_and_slide()
    
    # Check if reached waypoint
    if position.distance_to(target_position) < 10:
        current_waypoint = (current_waypoint + 1) % waypoints.size()

func chase_player(delta):
    var player = get_node('/root/Player')
    var direction = (player.position - position).normalized()
    velocity = direction * chase_speed
    move_and_slide()
    
    # Check if player is in attack range
    if position.distance_to(player.position) < attack_range:
        attack()

func attack():
    print("Enemy attacking player!")
    # Add your attack logic here

func _on_Player_detected():
    player_detected = true

func _on_Player_lost():
    player_detected = false
```

# Tự động hóa hành vi AI của kẻ địch trong Godot

Dưới đây là script để tự động hóa hành vi AI của kẻ địch trong game Godot của bạn. Script này sẽ giúp kẻ địch tuần tra giữa các waypoint, đuổi theo người chơi khi phát hiện và tấn công khi vào phạm vi.

```gdscript
extends CharacterBody2D

# Các waypoint để tuần tra
var waypoints = []
var current_waypoint = 0
var speed = 200
var chase_speed = 300
var attack_range = 200
var player_detected = false

func _ready():
    # Khởi tạo các waypoint (thay thế bằng waypoint của riêng bạn)
    waypoints = [$Vector2(100, 100), $Vector2(300, 100), $Vector2(300, 300), $Vector2(100, 300)]

func _process(delta):
    if player_detected:
        chase_player(delta)
    else:
        patrol(delta)

func patrol(delta):
    var target_position = waypoints[current_waypoint]
    var direction = (target_position - position).normalized()
    velocity = direction * speed
    move_and_slide()
    
    # Kiểm tra xem đã đến waypoint chưa
    if position.distance_to(target_position) < 10:
        current_waypoint = (current_waypoint + 1) % waypoints.size()

func chase_player(delta):
    var player = get_node('/root/Player')
    var direction = (player.position - position).normalized()
    velocity = direction * chase_speed
    move_and_slide()
    
    # Kiểm tra xem người chơi có trong phạm vi tấn công không
    if position.distance_to(player.position) < attack_range:
        attack()

func attack():
    print("Enemy attacking player!")
    # Thêm logic tấn công của bạn tại đây

func _on_Player_detected():
    player_detected = true

func _on_Player_lost():
    player_detected = false
```
